```{r load data}
library(tictoc)
library(beepr)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(xgboost)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(tidyr)

tic()

# ============================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================

df <- fread("/Users/Jujou/Documents/Repos/GRP-6_DS-Project/DS-Project_data/Intermediate/cleaned_data.csv")

target <- "int_rate"

df <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.numeric))
df_num <- df %>% select(where(is.numeric))

# ============================
# TRAIN / VAL / TEST SPLIT
# ============================

set.seed(123)

n <- nrow(df_num)
idx <- sample(1:n)

train_idx <- idx[1:floor(0.70*n)]
val_idx   <- idx[(floor(0.70*n)+1):floor(0.85*n)]
test_idx  <- idx[(floor(0.85*n)+1):n]

train <- df_num[train_idx, ]
val   <- df_num[val_idx, ]
test  <- df_num[test_idx, ]

train_x <- as.matrix(train %>% select(-all_of(target)))
train_y <- train[[target]]

val_x <- as.matrix(val %>% select(-all_of(target)))
val_y <- val[[target]]

test_x <- as.matrix(test %>% select(-all_of(target)))
test_y <- test[[target]]

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(train_x, label=train_y)
dval   <- xgb.DMatrix(val_x, label=val_y)

# ============================
# DEFINE HYPERPARAMETER GRID
# ============================

grid <- expand.grid(
eta = c(0.01),
max_depth = c(4),
min_child_weight = c(1),
subsample = c(0.6),
colsample_bytree = c(0.6),
gamma = c(1)
)

results <- list()

# ============================
# TRAIN MODELS
# ============================

for (i in 1:nrow(grid)) {

  params <- list(
    booster = "gbtree",
    objective = "reg:squarederror",
    eta = grid$eta[i],
    max_depth = grid$max_depth[i],
    min_child_weight = grid$min_child_weight[i],
    subsample = grid$subsample[i],
    colsample_bytree = grid$colsample_bytree[i],
    gamma = grid$gamma[i]
  )
  
  model <- xgb.train(
    params = params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 500,
    watchlist = list(train = dtrain, val = dval), # Changed 'evals' to 'watchlist'
    verbose = 0,
    early_stopping_rounds = 25
  )
  
  # Predictions
  
  pred_train <- predict(model, train_x)
  pred_val   <- predict(model, val_x)
  
  # Metrics
  
  rmse_train <- RMSE(pred_train, train_y)
  rmse_val   <- RMSE(pred_val, val_y)
  r2_train <- 1 - sum((pred_train - train_y)^2) / sum((train_y - mean(train_y))^2)
  r2_val   <- 1 - sum((pred_val - val_y)^2) / sum((val_y - mean(val_y))^2)
  
  # Store all hyperparameters
  
  results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    model_id = i,
    eta = grid$eta[i],
    max_depth = grid$max_depth[i],
    min_child_weight = grid$min_child_weight[i],
    subsample = grid$subsample[i],
    colsample_bytree = grid$colsample_bytree[i],
    gamma = grid$gamma[i],
    rmse_train = rmse_train,
    rmse_val = rmse_val,
    r2_train = r2_train,
    r2_val = r2_val
  )
}

results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)

# ============================
# BEST MODEL BY RMSE
# ============================

best_model_row <- results_df[which.min(results_df$rmse_val), ]
best_model_row

# ============================
# TOP 10 MODELS
# ============================

top10 <- results_df %>% arrange(rmse_val) %>% head(10)
top10

# ============================
# PLOT RMSE vs HYPERPARAMETERS
# ============================

hyperparams <- c("eta", "max_depth", "subsample", "colsample_bytree")

for (hp in hyperparams) {

df_plot <- melt(
  results_df[, c(hp, "rmse_train", "rmse_val")],
  id.vars = hp,
  variable.name = "type",
  value.name = "rmse"
)

print(
ggplot(df_plot, aes_string(x = hp, y = "rmse", color = "type")) +
geom_line() +
geom_point(size=2) +
theme_minimal() +
labs(title = paste("RMSE vs", hp), x = hp, y = "RMSE")
)
}

# ============================
# PLOT R2 vs HYPERPARAMETERS
# ============================

for (hp in hyperparams) {

df_plot <- melt(
results_df[, c(hp, "r2_train", "r2_val")],
id.vars = hp,
variable.name = "type",
value.name = "r2"
)

print(
ggplot(df_plot, aes_string(x = hp, y = "r2", color = "type")) +
geom_line() +
geom_point(size=2) +
theme_minimal() +
labs(title = paste("R² vs", hp), x = hp, y = "R²")
)
}


beep(sound=2)
toc()

```


```{r}

# ============================================================
# 7. TRAIN FINAL MODEL USING BEST HYPERPARAMETERS
# ============================================================
best_params <- list(
  booster = "gbtree",
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eta = best_model_row$eta,
  max_depth = best_model_row$max_depth,
  subsample = best_model_row$subsample,
  colsample_bytree = best_model_row$colsample_bytree
  # 'evals' removed from here
)

final_model <- xgb.train(
  params = best_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain, val = dval), # Correct argument name
  verbose = 0,
  early_stopping_rounds = 25
)

# TEST SET PERFORMANCE
pred_test <- predict(final_model, test_x)
test_rmse <- RMSE(pred_test, test_y)

cat("\nFinal Test RMSE:", test_rmse, "\n")

```
